# PhysicsLayer 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Physics](Blitz3D-Physics)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PhysicsLayer:Void entity:Int32, layer:Int32, mask_low:Int32=-1, mask_high:Int32=-1
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `entity` | In | Int32 | required | The body. |
| `layer` | In | Int32 | required | 0 to 63. |
| `mask_low` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Layers 0 to 31 that it collides with. |
| `mask_high` | In | Int32 | `-1` | Layers 32 to 63 that it collides with. |

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets which layer a body is in and which layers it collides with. Two bodies collide only if each one has the layer of the other in its mask. Bodies are in layer 0 and collide with all layers by default.

The mask has a bit for each of the 64 layers, split into two numbers of 32 bits: bit n of `mask_low` is layer n, bit n of `mask_high` is layer 32 + n. -1 sets all bits.

## Differences

* The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Ghosts (layer 1) pass through walls (layer 2) but not through each other.
PhysicsLayer ghost, 1, ~(1 Shl 2), -1
PhysicsLayer wall, 2, -1, -1
```
